instantiated_cells.justification: The statute defines a "lobbyist" as any individual employed by a principal or who "contracts for or receives economic consideration, other than reimbursement for actual expenses," with no minimum dollar threshold.
The lobbyist definition in §13.62(11) contains no expenditure threshold for the lobbyist; expenditure thresholds in §13.64(1) apply to principals, not to defining a lobbyist by their own spending.

Section 13.68 requires reporting an aggregate total of lobbying expenditures rather than itemizing individual expenditures by per-item amount; no per-item itemization de minimis threshold is defined in the statute.

Section 13.64(1) requires registration only when a principal's lobbying expenditures/obligations exceed $500 in a calendar year, and §13.621(5) allows a verified statement (in lieu of full registration/reporting) for principals not exceeding $500 aggregate.

unscoreable_emissions.reason: The Wisconsin statute contains no percentage-of-compensated-time threshold exempting a lobbyist from filing disclosure. Section 13.68(1)(a) uses an absolute hours threshold (10 hours per reporting period) for excluding non-lobbyist employees of a principal from the principal's aggregate, not a percent-of-time exemption from lobbyist filing.

content.text:
I'll analyze each row against the Wisconsin statute text.

**Row 001** - Lobbyist compensation threshold: §13.62(11) defines "lobbyist" as someone who "is employed by a principal, or contracts for or receives economic consideration, other than reimbursement for actual expenses." No dollar threshold — any economic consideration qualifies.

**Row 002** - Lobbyist-side expenditure threshold for registration: The statute imposes expenditure thresholds on principals (§13.64 - $500), not on lobbyists themselves. No lobbyist-side expenditure standard exists.

**Row 003** - Time standard in lobbyist definition: §13.62(11) — "If an individual's duties on behalf of a principal are not limited exclusively to lobbying, the individual is a lobbyist only if he or she makes lobbying communications on each of at least 5 days within a reporting period."

**Row 004** - Per-item itemization threshold on lobbyist spending reports: §13.68(1)(a)6 requires listing lobbyists by name if expenditures exceed $200. §13.68(1)(a)5 requires inclusion if grassroots lobbying exceeds $500. The statute aggregates rather than itemizes individual expenditures generally — no per-item itemization de minimis appears.

**Row 005** - Overall filing-exemption threshold: §13.621(5) and §13.64(1) — principals with aggregate lobbying expenditures/obligations not exceeding $500 in a calendar year are exempt (may file verified statement instead of full registration/reporting).

**Row 006** - Time-percent filing exemption for lobbyist: §13.68(1)(a) excludes from aggregate reporting "any employee of the principal who is not a lobbyist and who devotes not more than 10 hours to lobbying during a reporting period" — this is an hours threshold, not a percent of compensated time, and applies to principal reporting not lobbyist filing exemption.
